table.retrieve:
SELECT
	documentcode = :ai_PurInvCode, 
	pd.icode,
	pl.date, 
	pl.posted,
	pl.postdate, 
	itemalias=i.customicode, 
	itemname=i.name, 
	suppliername=a.name, 
	supplieralias=a.aliasname, 
	qty=SUM((pd.looseqty + pd.packqty + pd.bonusqty) * case when pl.purcatcode <= 2 THEN pd.packunits ELSE 1 END),
	netrate =MAX((PD.PurPrice * (PD.LooseQty + PD.PackQty) * 
			(1 - PD.DiscPerc * .01) * ( 1 - PL.discperc * .01 ) + 
			(PD.unitsalestax * ( PD.Looseqty + PD.PackQty + PD.bonusqty )) +  
		Round( PD.PurPrice * (PD.LooseQty + PD.PackQty) * (1 - PD.DiscPerc * .01) * 0.01 * PD.gstperc, 2) +
		( Round((Round(Round(PD.PurPrice * (PD.LooseQty + PD.PackQty) * 
					(1 - PD.DiscPerc * .01),2) * 
			(1 -  PL.discperc * 0.01),2) - PL.flatdisc) * 0.01 *  PL.invgstperc1 ,2)) ) /
			(PD.Looseqty + PD.PackQty*PD.packunits + PD.bonusqty * case when pl.purcatcode <= 2 THEN pd.packunits ELSE 1 END)),
	/*netrate = MAX((PD.PurPrice * (PD.LooseQty + PD.PackQty) * 
			(1 - PD.DiscPerc * .01) * ( 1 - PL.discperc * .01 ) + 
			(PD.unitsalestax * ( PD.Looseqty + PD.PackQty + PD.bonusqty )) +  
		Round( PD.PurPrice * (PD.LooseQty + PD.PackQty) * (1 - PD.DiscPerc * .01) * 0.01 * PD.gstperc, 2) +
		( Round((Round(Round(PD.PurPrice * (PD.LooseQty + PD.PackQty) * 
					(1 - PD.DiscPerc * .01),2) * 
			(1 -  PL.discperc * 0.01),2) - PL.flatdisc) * 0.01 *  PL.invgstperc1 ,2)) ) /
			(PD.Looseqty + PD.PackQty+ PD.bonusqty )),*/
	opstock=(SELECT	ISNULL(sum((packqty + bonusqty) * packunits),0) as netqty
		from	purdetail, purledger
		where	purledger.purcatcode in (1,2) and 
			purledger.purinvcode = purdetail.purinvcode and 
			posted = 'Y' and 
			purdetail.icode=pd.icode and 
			purledger.postdate < pl.postdate) +
		(select	ISNULL(sum(looseqty +  bonusqty), 0) as netqty
		from	purdetail, purledger
		where	purledger.purcatcode in (3,7,8) and 
			purledger.purinvcode = purdetail.purinvcode and 
			posted = 'Y' and 
			purdetail.icode=pd.icode AND
			purledger.postdate < pl.postdate) +
		(select	- ISNULL(sum(looseqty +  bonusqty), 0) as netqty
		from	prdetail, prledger
		where	prledger.prinvcode = prdetail.prinvcode and 
			prdetail.icode=pd.icode and 
			prledger.date < pl.postdate) +
		(select	- ISNULL(sum(looseqty+bonusqty), 0) as netqty
		from	saledetail, saleledger
		where	saleledger.saleinvcode = saledetail.saleinvcode and 
			due is null and 
			saledetail.icode=pd.icode and 
			saleledger.date < pl.postdate) + 
		(select	ISNULL(sum(looseqty+bonusqty), 0) as netqty
		from	srdetail, srledger
		where	srledger.srinvcode = srdetail.srinvcode and 
			srdetail.icode=pd.icode and 
			srledger.date < pl.postdate) +
		(select	- ISNULL(sum(duesatisfyqty), 0) as netqty
		from	duesatisfydetail, duesatisfyheader
		where	duesatisfyheader.duesatisfycode = duesatisfydetail.duesatisfycode and 
			duesatisfydetail.icode=pd.icode and 
			duesatisfyheader.duesatisfydate < pl.postdate) +
		(select	- ISNULL(sum(qty), 0) as netqty
		from	issuedetail, issueheader
		where	issueheader.issueinvcode = issuedetail.issueinvcode and 
			issuedetail.icode=pd.icode and 
			issueheader.date < pl.postdate) +
		(select	ISNULL(sum(qty), 0) as netqty
		from	receiptdetail, receiptheader
		where	receiptheader.receiptinvcode = receiptdetail.receiptinvcode and 
			posted='Y' and 
			receiptdetail.icode=pd.icode and 
			receiptheader.postdate < pl.postdate) +
		(select	ISNULL(sum(case adjcatcode when 1 then looseqty when 2 then -looseqty end), 0) as netqty
		from	adjdetail, adjheader
		where	adjheader.adjcode = adjdetail.adjcode and 
			adjdetail.icode=pd.icode and 
			adjheader.date < pl.postdate),
	clstock=(SELECT	ISNULL(sum((packqty + bonusqty) * packunits),0) as netqty
		from	purdetail, purledger
		where	purledger.purcatcode in (1,2) and 
			purledger.purinvcode = purdetail.purinvcode and 
			posted = 'Y' and 
			purdetail.icode=pd.icode and 
			purledger.postdate <= :ad_enddate) +
		(select	ISNULL(sum(looseqty +  bonusqty), 0) as netqty
		from	purdetail, purledger
		where	purledger.purcatcode in (3,7,8) and 
			purledger.purinvcode = purdetail.purinvcode and 
			posted = 'Y' and 
			purdetail.icode=pd.icode AND
			purledger.postdate <= :ad_enddate) +
		(select	- ISNULL(sum(looseqty +  bonusqty), 0) as netqty
		from	prdetail, prledger
		where	prledger.prinvcode = prdetail.prinvcode and 
			prdetail.icode=pd.icode and 
			prledger.date <= :ad_enddate) +
		(select	- ISNULL(sum(looseqty+bonusqty), 0) as netqty
		from	saledetail, saleledger
		where	saleledger.saleinvcode = saledetail.saleinvcode and 
			due is null and 
			saledetail.icode=pd.icode and 
			saleledger.date <= :ad_enddate) + 
		(select	ISNULL(sum(looseqty+bonusqty), 0) as netqty
		from	srdetail, srledger
		where	srledger.srinvcode = srdetail.srinvcode and 
			srdetail.icode=pd.icode and 
			srledger.date <= :ad_enddate) +
		(select	- ISNULL(sum(duesatisfyqty), 0) as netqty
		from	duesatisfydetail, duesatisfyheader
		where	duesatisfyheader.duesatisfycode = duesatisfydetail.duesatisfycode and 
			duesatisfydetail.icode=pd.icode and 
			duesatisfyheader.duesatisfydate <= :ad_enddate) +
		(select	- ISNULL(sum(qty), 0) as netqty
		from	issuedetail, issueheader
		where	issueheader.issueinvcode = issuedetail.issueinvcode and 
			issuedetail.icode=pd.icode and 
			issueheader.date <= :ad_enddate) +
		(select	ISNULL(sum(qty), 0) as netqty
		from	receiptdetail, receiptheader
		where	receiptheader.receiptinvcode = receiptdetail.receiptinvcode and 
			posted='Y' and 
			receiptdetail.icode=pd.icode and 
			receiptheader.postdate <= :ad_enddate) +
		(select	ISNULL(sum(case adjcatcode when 1 then looseqty when 2 then -looseqty end), 0) as netqty
		from	adjdetail, adjheader
		where	adjheader.adjcode = adjdetail.adjcode and 
			adjdetail.icode=pd.icode and 
			adjheader.date <= :ad_enddate),
	supplierpurchase=(SELECT	ISNULL(sum((packqty + bonusqty) * packunits),0) as netqty
		from	purdetail, purledger
		where	purledger.purcatcode in (1,2) and 
			purledger.purinvcode = purdetail.purinvcode and 
			posted = 'Y' and 
			purdetail.icode=pd.icode and 
			purledger.postdate >= pl.postdate and 
			purledger.postdate <= :ad_enddate and 
			purledger.purinvcode <> pl.purinvcode and
			purledger.suppcode = pl.suppcode) +
		(select	ISNULL(sum(looseqty +  bonusqty), 0) as netqty
		from	purdetail, purledger
		where	purledger.purcatcode in (3,7,8) and 
			purledger.purinvcode = purdetail.purinvcode and 
			posted = 'Y' and 
			purdetail.icode=pd.icode AND
			purledger.postdate >= pl.postdate and 
			purledger.postdate <= :ad_enddate and 
			purledger.purinvcode <> pl.purinvcode and
			purledger.suppcode = pl.suppcode),
	supplierpurreturn=(select ISNULL(sum(looseqty +  bonusqty), 0) as netqty
		from	prdetail, prledger
		where	prledger.prinvcode = prdetail.prinvcode and 
			prdetail.icode=pd.icode and 
			prledger.date >= pl.postdate and 
			prledger.date <= :ad_enddate and
			prledger.suppcode = pl.suppcode),
	otherpurchase=(SELECT	ISNULL(sum((packqty + bonusqty) * packunits),0) as netqty
		from	purdetail, purledger
		where	purledger.purcatcode in (1,2) and 
			purledger.purinvcode = purdetail.purinvcode and 
			posted = 'Y' and 
			purdetail.icode=pd.icode and 
			purledger.postdate >= pl.postdate and 
			purledger.postdate <= :ad_enddate and 
			purledger.purinvcode <> pl.purinvcode and
			purledger.suppcode <> pl.suppcode) +
		(select	ISNULL(sum(looseqty +  bonusqty), 0) as netqty
		from	purdetail, purledger
		where	purledger.purcatcode in (3,7,8) and 
			purledger.purinvcode = purdetail.purinvcode and 
			posted = 'Y' and 
			purdetail.icode=pd.icode AND
			purledger.postdate >= pl.postdate and 
			purledger.postdate <= :ad_enddate and 
			purledger.purinvcode <> pl.purinvcode and
			purledger.suppcode <> pl.suppcode),
	otherpurreturn=(select ISNULL(sum(looseqty +  bonusqty), 0) as netqty
		from	prdetail, prledger
		where	prledger.prinvcode = prdetail.prinvcode and 
			prdetail.icode=pd.icode and 
			prledger.date >= pl.postdate and 
			prledger.date <= :ad_enddate and
			prledger.suppcode <> pl.suppcode),
	netsale=isnull((select sum(isnull(looseqty + bonusqty, 0))
		from saledetail sd, saleledger sl 
		where	sd.icode = pd.icode and
			sl.date >= pl.postdate and 
			sl.date <= :ad_enddate and
			sd.due is null and
			sl.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode), 0) + 
		isnull((select - sum(isnull(looseqty + bonusqty, 0))
		from srdetail sd, srledger sl 
		where	sd.icode = pd.icode and
			sl.date >= pl.postdate and 
			sl.date <= :ad_enddate and
			sl.srinvcode = sd.srinvcode), 0),
	netsalevalue=isnull((select sum(isnull(looseqty, 0) * (sd.saleprice - sd.itemflatdisc) * (1 - sd.discperc * .01) * (1 - sl.discperc * .01))
		from saledetail sd, saleledger sl 
		where	sd.icode = pd.icode and
			sl.date >= pl.postdate and 
			sl.date <= :ad_enddate and
			sd.due is null and
			sl.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode), 0) + 
		isnull((select - sum(isnull(looseqty, 0) * sd.srprice * (1 - sd.discperc * .01) * (1 - sl.discperc * .01) )
		from srdetail sd, srledger sl 
		where	sd.icode = pd.icode and
			sl.date >= pl.postdate and 
			sl.date <= :ad_enddate and
			sl.srinvcode = sd.srinvcode), 0),
	costvalue=isnull((select sum(isnull(looseqty * sd.avgprice, 0))
		from saledetail sd, saleledger sl 
		where	sd.icode = pd.icode and
			sl.date >= pl.postdate and 
			sl.date <= :ad_enddate and
			sd.due is null and
			sl.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode), 0) + 
		isnull((select -sum(isnull(looseqty * sd.avgprice, 0))
		from srdetail sd, srledger sl 
		where	sd.icode = pd.icode and
			sl.date >= pl.postdate and 
			sl.date <= :ad_enddate and
			sl.srinvcode = sd.srinvcode), 0),
	adjustment=isnull((select ISNULL(sum(case adjcatcode when 1 then looseqty when 2 then -looseqty end), 0) as netqty
		from	adjdetail, adjheader
		where	adjheader.adjcode = adjdetail.adjcode and 
			adjdetail.icode=pd.icode and 
			adjheader.date >= pl.postdate and
			adjheader.date <= :ad_enddate), 0),
	issuereceipt = isnull((select	- ISNULL(sum(qty), 0) as netqty
		from	issuedetail, issueheader
		where	issueheader.issueinvcode = issuedetail.issueinvcode and 
			issuedetail.icode=pd.icode and 
			issueheader.date >= pl.postdate and
			issueheader.date <= :ad_enddate), 0) +
		isnull((select	ISNULL(sum(qty), 0) as netqty
		from	receiptdetail, receiptheader
		where	receiptheader.receiptinvcode = receiptdetail.receiptinvcode and 
			posted='Y' and 
			receiptdetail.icode=pd.icode and 
			receiptheader.postdate >= pl.postdate and
			receiptheader.postdate <= :ad_enddate), 0),
	i.avgprice,
	i.saleprice

FROM
	purledger pl, purdetail pd, item i, accounts a
WHERE
	pl.purinvcode = :ai_purinvcode and 
	pl.purinvcode=pd.purinvcode and
	pl.suppcode = a.acccode and
	pd.icode = i.icode
GROUP BY
	pl.purinvcode,
	pl.postdate,
	pl.date,
	pl.posted,
	pd.icode,
	i.customicode,
	i.name,
	pl.suppcode,
	a.name,
	a.aliasname, 
	i.avgprice,
	i.saleprice
ORDER BY
	I.Name,
	I.CustomICode,
	A.Name,
	A.AliasName
